responses: 👋 Hey there! I'm CampusBuddy — your campus guide. Ask me about college timings, labs, clubs, canteen, complaints, or anything campus-related!
Hello! CampusBuddy at your service. 🎓 What can I help you with today?
Hi! Ready to help you navigate campus life. What do you need?

🕗 **College Timings:**

• **Morning Session:** 8:00 AM – 12:30 PM
• **Afternoon Session:** 1:30 PM – 5:00 PM
• **Office Hours:** 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM (Mon–Sat)
• **Saturday:** 8:00 AM – 1:00 PM
• **Sunday:** Closed

Gates open 30 minutes before class starts. ✅

💻 **Computer Lab Details:**

• **Location:** Block B, 2nd Floor — Room No. 204 & 206
• **Timings:** 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM (Mon–Sat)
• **Free Slots:** Available during non-lecture hours
• **Booking:** Contact the lab assistant or your department coordinator

Bring your ID card for entry. ✅

🍽️ **Canteen Info:**

• **Location:** Ground Floor, near the Main Block entrance
• **Timings:**
  - Breakfast: 8:00 AM – 9:30 AM
  - Lunch: 12:30 PM – 2:00 PM
  - Snacks & Tea: 3:30 PM – 5:00 PM
• **Menu:** South Indian breakfast, rice meals, sandwiches, juices & snacks
• **Payment:** Cash & UPI accepted ✅

📅 **Holiday Information:**

For the official holiday list, check:
• **ERP Portal → Academic Calendar** section
• **Notice Board** near the Admin Block

📌 Common holidays include:
• National Holidays (Republic Day, Independence Day, Gandhi Jayanti)
• Festival Holidays (Pongal, Diwali, Eid, Christmas)
• College Annual Day & Sports Day

Always verify with your class coordinator for last-minute changes. ✅

📝 **How to Register a Complaint:**

**Step 1:** Log in to the **ERP Portal**
**Step 2:** Go to **'Grievance Cell'** section
**Step 3:** Fill in your complaint details clearly
**Step 4:** Submit — you'll get a reference number

📌 Alternatively:
• Visit the **Student Affairs Office** (Block A, Room 101)
• Email: grievance@yourcollege.edu

All complaints are reviewed within **3–5 working days**. ✅

💡 **Coding Club — CampusCode:**

• **Focus:** DSA, Web Dev, Competitive Programming, Hackathons
• **Meetings:** Every Saturday, 10:00 AM – 12:00 PM
• **Venue:** Computer Lab 204, Block B
• **How to Join:** Fill the form on the Notice Board or contact the club coordinator

🏆 Past activities: Internal hackathons, LeetCode contests, project showcases

Open to all branches & years. ✅

🎯 **Student Clubs at Campus:**

| Club | Focus | Meeting Day |
|------|-------|-------------|
| 💻 CampusCode | Coding & Tech | Saturday |
| 🤖 Robotics Club | Hardware & AI | Friday |
| 🎵 Music Club | Vocals & Instruments | Wednesday |
| 🎨 Art & Design | Creative Arts | Thursday |
| 📸 Photography Club | Clicks & Edits | Sunday |
| 📢 NSS | Social Service | Monthly |

Contact your Student Affairs Office or check the notice board to register! ✅

💪 **You've got this!**

*"Success is not final, failure is not fatal — it is the courage to continue that counts."* — Winston Churchill

Remember: Every expert was once a beginner. Every pro was once an amateur. Keep going, one step at a time. 🚀
🌟 Hey, tough days are part of the journey! The fact that you showed up today already makes you ahead of the person who gave up. Believe in your process. 💛
🎓 College is hard — but so are you. Take a break, breathe, and come back stronger. You're building something great. Keep pushing! 🔥

📚 **Library Details:**

• **Location:** Block C, Ground Floor
• **Timings:** 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM (Mon–Sat)
• **Books Available:** 10,000+ titles across all departments
• **Borrowing:** Up to 3 books at a time, for 14 days
• **Fine:** ₹2/day per book for late return
• **e-Resources:** Available via ERP Portal → Digital Library ✅

📶 **Campus Wi-Fi:**

• **Network Name:** CampusNet_Student
• **Access:** Use your college roll number as username
• **Password:** Your ERP portal password
• **Coverage:** All blocks, canteen, and library
• **Speed:** Up to 100 Mbps shared

⚠️ Issues? Contact IT Support — Block A, Room 005 or email: itsupport@yourcollege.edu ✅

📋 **Exam Information:**

• **Internal Assessments:** Announced by individual faculty — check your class group
• **Semester Exams:** Published on ERP Portal under **'Exam Schedule'** 2 weeks prior
• **Hall Tickets:** Available on ERP Portal 1 week before exams
• **Results:** Published within 3–4 weeks after exam

📌 For exam-related issues, contact the Exam Cell — Admin Block, Room 102. ✅

💳 **Fee Payment:**

• **Portal:** Log in to ERP → **'Fee Payment'** section
• **Modes:** Online (UPI, Net Banking, Debit/Credit Card) or Cash at the Accounts Office
• **Accounts Office:** Block A, Ground Floor — 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM
• **Receipt:** Auto-generated on ERP after payment

⚠️ Pay before the due date to avoid a late fine. Check ERP for current due dates. ✅

📊 **Attendance Details:**

• **Minimum Required:** 75% to be eligible for exams
• **Check:** ERP Portal → **'My Attendance'**
• **Updates:** Reflected within 24 hours of class
• **Shortage Letter:** Issued if attendance falls below 65%

📌 For medical leave or genuine reasons, submit a leave letter to your class coordinator within 3 days. ✅

😄 Why do programmers prefer dark mode?

Because light attracts **bugs**! 🐛

😂 A student asked the professor: 'Will this be on the exam?'
Professor: 'Everything is on the exam.'
Student: 'Even the attendance?' 💀

🤣 Why did the student eat his homework?
Because the teacher told him it was a **piece of cake**! 🎂
😊 You're welcome! Happy to help anytime. If you have more questions, just ask!
🎓 Glad I could help! Come back whenever you need campus info. Good luck! 🌟
No problem at all! That's what I'm here for. 🤝
👋 Goodbye! Have a productive day on campus! 🎓
See you later! Come back anytime you need help. 🚀
Take care! All the best with your studies! 💪
